body:
I'm prescribed 30mg of adderall so I tend to mix it with everything I do without realizing it. I'm not addicted to it at all. It just so happens every time I party I take some addy so I'm not tired. ( I am the one that usually drives my friends home after clubs and raves so I have to stay awake.)
I know  this mixture is very dangerous and its easy to get out of hand like I have before. There have been nights where I have combined 90mg of adderall IR with a gram of MDMA. That night was crazy but never again. What I normally take is 30mg of adderall mixed with anywhere from .2-.8 mg of MDMA. (depending on how long I have waited between my rolls) This mixture works for me. I'm more awake and it makes the roll seem stronger.
The biggest downside of this combo is the comedown. I'm not only getting the comedown from MDMA but also the comedown from speed. The two comedowns mixed are brutal. I become sick to my stomach. Lights are impossible to look at. I can't fall asleep due to the speed so I have to endure everything. I cant just close my eyes and fall asleep like I normally do while coming down from MDMA.
Take care and be safe everyone,
Dex
